name: gaming-house
description: Gaming House Windows station and development backend

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.verify: npm run contract:lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run agent:build && npm run agent:check && npm run agent:test && npm run test:system && npm run test:native
scripts.build:sample: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts --mode sample && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.start:native: npm run agent:build && npm run build && electron apps/desktop/dist-electron/main.js --dev-agent
scripts.test:native: npm run build && npm run agent:build && dotnet build tools/test-game/GH.TestGame.csproj && node --test tests/native-launch.integration.mjs
